Privacy policy

Your artwork is processed only to complete your conversion. When you select Convert, the image is sent securely to this app’s conversion service, processed in memory, and returned to your browser.

This app does not intentionally retain, sell, train on, or share uploaded images. It does not require an account and does not use advertising or tracking cookies. Conversion results remain in your browser unless you download them.

Vercel hosts the website and conversion function and may process ordinary connection information such as an IP address, request metadata, and browser details to deliver and protect the service. Do not upload sensitive or confidential images.

Accessibility

The converter supports keyboard navigation, visible focus indicators, screen-reader labels, status announcements, reduced-motion preferences, and a high-contrast mode.

Material choices are identified by names, types, counts, and hex values—not color alone. Controls pair sliders with editable number fields.

If part of the converter is difficult to use, report the image format, browser, and the control that caused trouble in the project’s GitHub issues.

How it works

  1. Detect the source artwork’s pixel grid using edges and repeated spacing.
  2. Choose one solid representative color for every detected cell.
  3. Optionally flood-fill the outside background while preserving enclosed areas.
  4. Find the nearest average color among Terraria blocks and walls.
